description: This file declares the IpcFactory class, which implements the IIpcFactory interface for creating IPC server components within the Rialto media server. It defines factory methods for creating application management and session management servers, and includes standard class constructors and delete operators.

classes.name: IpcFactory
classes.description: Implements the IIpcFactory interface to create IPC server components for the Rialto media server.

methods.name: createApplicationManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an ApplicationManagementServer, using the provided session server manager.

methods.name: createSessionManagementServer
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a SessionManagementServer, using the provided playback, cdm, and control services.
